raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":2972,"db1":"MYSQL","query1":"SELECT mmsi FROM transportation.vessel WHERE endurance > 45","db2":"POSTGRESQL","query2":"SELECT DISTINCT mmsi FROM public.vessel_ais_data WHERE mmsi IN (result) AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND longitude BETWEEN 122.0 AND 122.2 AND latitude BETWEEN 30.0 AND 30.2 AND sog < 3"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"自持力超过45天的船舶","tables":["MYSQL:transportation.vessel"],"columns":["mmsi","endurance"]},{"requirement":"最近24小时内","tables":["POSTGRESQL:public.vessel_ais_data"],"columns":["timestamp"]},{"requirement":"位于(122.0, 30.0)至(122.2, 30.2)矩形内","tables":["POSTGRESQL:public.vessel_ais_data"],"columns":["longitude","latitude"]},{"requirement":"速度小于3节","tables":["POSTGRESQL:public.vessel_ais_data"],"columns":["sog"]},{"requirement":"输出MMSI","tables":["POSTGRESQL:public.vessel_ais_data"],"columns":["mmsi"]}],"assumptions":["自持力字段endurance为VARCHAR类型，可能包含非纯数字内容；假设其存储的数值部分可直接与45比较，若包含单位或非数字字符则需额外解析。","矩形范围按经纬度边界包含端点处理，即经度[122.0,122.2]、纬度[30.0,30.2]。"]}
